title: Synthetic exchange item availability check (draft RFC 0008 quantifier)
description: Synthetic re-encoding of census fact R5:/request/allNewItemsAvailable, scoped to the availability conjunct a quantifier reaches. Invented content for specification testing; it authorizes nothing. This twin quantifies over the requested new items instead of reading a prepared boolean, and is NOT valid under JPS 0.1.0-draft.

decision.intent: Decide whether a requested item exchange may proceed on availability grounds alone.
decision.question: Is every requested new item available?

outcomes.label: Exchange allowed
outcomes.description: Every requested new item is available.

outcomes.label: Exchange refused
outcomes.description: At least one requested new item is not available.

rules.description: Every requested new item is available in the catalog.
